description: This file serves as an ASGI shim module to support Uvicorn and other ASGI servers by importing and re-exporting the FastAPI application instance from its canonical location. It provides a compatibility layer for startup commands and environment constraints.

methods.name: get_asgi_app()
methods.description: Returns the FastAPI application instance imported from the canonical module source.

ctags.name: _app
ctags.pattern: /^    from src.api.main import app as _app  # local import to avoid global aliasing$/

ctags.name: app
ctags.pattern: /^from src.api.main import app as app  # noqa: E402,F401$/
